name: localpilot
description: Private, CPU-first local AI coding assistant for VS Code powered by QVAC.

localpilot.qvacPath.markdownDescription: Optional path to the QVAC CLI executable or JavaScript entry point. Leave empty to resolve `qvac` from PATH. On Windows this is commonly `%APPDATA%\npm\qvac.cmd`.

localpilot.nodePath.markdownDescription: Optional path to a Node.js 22.21+ or 24.9+ executable used to run the QVAC CLI. Leave empty to use the Node bundled in the Windows all-in-one VSIX, then PATH. The Windows `win32-x64` package includes Node.

localpilot.host.description: Loopback address used by the local QVAC server. Non-loopback addresses are rejected.

localpilot.port.description: Local port for the QVAC OpenAI-compatible server. Restart the runtime after changing it.

localpilot.modelId.description: QVAC catalog model constant. LocalPilot is tested with QWEN3_600M_INST_Q4.

localpilot.modelPath.markdownDescription: Optional absolute path to a local llama.cpp-compatible `.gguf` chat model. When set, LocalPilot uses QVAC's explicit `{ src, type: "llamacpp-completion" }` config instead of downloading a catalog model. Use **LocalPilot: Choose Model or Local GGUF** to pick a file. Local files are not checksum-verified by QVAC.

localpilot.modelAlias.description: Alias used by the local OpenAI-compatible API for the configured model.

localpilot.contextSize.description: Context window in tokens (input plus generated output) for the model.

localpilot.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum number of generated tokens per response.

localpilot.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Lower values are more deterministic.

localpilot.enableReasoning.description: Enable hybrid-model reasoning/thinking output. Disabled by default because it is much slower on CPU.

localpilot.maxSelectionChars.description: Maximum number of selected characters sent by Explain Selected Code. Larger selections are rejected instead of silently sending the whole file.

localpilot.startupTimeoutMs.description: Time allowed for the QVAC server to start and preload the model, including the first model download.

localpilot.requestTimeoutMs.description: Time allowed for one model response before the request is aborted.

localpilot.autoStart.description: Start the QVAC runtime automatically when Chat or Explain is used. When false, LocalPilot asks first because the initial model download requires internet.

localpilot.stopOnExit.description: Stop the QVAC process started by LocalPilot when VS Code shuts down. Servers that LocalPilot did not start are never killed.

localpilot.autoInstallQvac.description: If the QVAC CLI is missing, offer to install it automatically into VS Code storage. The download is about 3 GB and requires internet. On Windows, Node/npm are bundled in the win32-x64 VSIX.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:webview
